description: This file defines the FileGet interface in the package com.salesmanager.core.modules.cms.content, providing methods to retrieve static content files from a Content Management System (CMS).

classes.name: FileGet
classes.description: An interface declaring methods to retrieve content files from the CMS, including fetching individual files, file names, and lists of files based on merchant store code and content type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content file based on merchant store code, content type, and content name.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of filenames for content files of a specific type within a merchant store.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of content files of a specific type for a merchant store.
